title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil designer (Kilmore or Shepparton VIC)
location: Shepparton, Kilmore, Echuca or Wangaratta VIC
content_text: Chris Smith & Associates careers page (read 15 Oct 2026 AEDT): 'Be part of a growing, regional firm with long-term career opportunities ... Apply now by sending your resume to admin@csmith.com.au.' Open listings are Land Surveyor and Licensed Surveyor; no civil engineering or design vacancy is listed, so this is a speculative enquiry. Home page: planning, surveying and engineering services across regional Victoria and Southern NSW; offices in Shepparton, Kilmore, Echuca and Wangaratta. Services page, Civil Engineering: 'Subdivision design and construction management, including road works, drainage, services etc.', retention basin and wetland design, preparation of as-constructed data (D-Spec, R-Spec), intersection and road widening design, DTP (Vic Roads) prequalified. About page: about 25 staff; team lists Tom Kerrins (Manager Engineering), Senior Engineering Designers, a Civil Engineer and a Construction Manager. Project pages: Lauriston Estate, a 182-lot low density subdivision at Grace Road, Shepparton North (design and documentation of roads, drainage, water, sewer and utilities, ongoing site supervision and quality control); Kilmore Recycled Water pump station and 4.4 km pipeline for Goulburn Valley Water (2021 to 2024).
apply_instructions: Email resume to admin@csmith.com.au as invited on https://www.csmith.com.au/careers. Label clearly as a speculative enquiry.
supported_contributions: Road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, plus Before You Dig Australia enquiries, from the Advanced Diploma (February 2026)
Site inspections, quality checks and drawing reviews from Philippines project-in-charge work in 2019
Site reports, material records and progress reports from residential subdivision finishing works as a field engineer 2019 to 2020
